trigger: target notices the shell is strategic
immediate_response: lower intensity and re-enter safer posture
repair_strategy: reduce direct ask and restore naturalness
repair_limit: if the target has already fixed the interpretation
upgrade_trigger: softness no longer reopens the door
collapse_threshold: target no longer accepts the legitimacy shell
notes: common in harmless-entry and friendly shells

trigger: timing no longer matches target attention or scene pressure
repair_strategy: reintroduce a lighter loop before re-asking
repair_limit: if the target has gone flat
upgrade_trigger: simple reciprocity no longer differentiates her
notes: frequent in long-term companionship and semi-public familiar scenes

trigger: the target fixes her role as friend, helper, or external support
immediate_response: stop pushing and re-enter a softer role
repair_strategy: use smaller residues and let role boundaries blur slowly
repair_limit: if the role label is already socially stabilized
upgrade_trigger: ordinary softness cannot move the label
notes: common in empathic-binding and familiarity-softening types

trigger: the target rejects the older explanation of the relationship
immediate_response: reduce explicit claims and seed residues
repair_cost: risk of looking stuck in the past
repair_limit: if the target has completed the new narrative

trigger: the room reads the character as too directive
repair_limit: if the crowd has already turned
upgrade_trigger: the room stops accepting the current performance style

trigger: the target starts counting costs in real time
immediate_response: slow down and restore voluntary tone
repair_limit: if the target now sees every move as a transaction
collapse_threshold: the target refuses the arrangement frame entirely

trigger: too much directness or stimulation too early
repair_strategy: reduce visibility and re-enter later with a lighter signal
repair_limit: if the target has already classified her as too much
upgrade_trigger: directness is no longer an asset

repair_strategy: introduce a new feedback shape or scene
repair_limit: if the target no longer feels seen
upgrade_trigger: simple feedback no longer retains attention
notes: seen in long-term companionship and empathic-binding styles

trigger: chosen knives cannot be used in sequence
immediate_response: drop the secondary knife and fall back to the primary
notes: this is a selector-level failure rather than a persona failure

trigger: no knife survives hard filters with usable fit
repair_strategy: gather information and wait for another window
repair_limit: if the same scene keeps failing
collapse_threshold: the target is no longer reachable in this scene
notes: should never be represented as collapse in packet output

trigger: the target experiences the move as a boundary invasion
immediate_response: back off immediately and reduce contact frequency
repair_strategy: return to lighter social contact and smaller asks
repair_limit: if the target now monitors every contact as suspect
collapse_threshold: the target treats proximity itself as the problem
notes: common in familiarity-softening and attachment-heavy styles

trigger: the audience flips from seeing her as composed to seeing her as performative
immediate_response: yield the stage and re-anchor in decorum
repair_strategy: minimize visible control and let another structure carry the scene
repair_limit: if the audience has already turned into critics

trigger: the role is fixed as helper, friend, or support with no path to upgrade
immediate_response: stop negotiating in the current frame
repair_strategy: reduce pressure and seed small boundary changes over time
repair_limit: if the social label is already institutionalized
upgrade_trigger: the old role cannot be expanded at all
notes: common in empathic-binding and role-anchor styles

trigger: the relationship becomes predictable and emotionally flat
immediate_response: refresh the reward pattern and introduce novelty
repair_strategy: shift scene, rhythm, or feedback cadence
repair_limit: if the target no longer feels any lift from the interaction
